signal: Magic Software posted a record Q3 with all-time high revenue on AI and cloud transformation demand, and is completing a merger with Matrix I.T. to boost US scale.

email.subject1: a signal play for Magic Software
email.body1:
Brian, saw Magic Software posted a record Q3 on AI and cloud demand and is closing the Matrix I.T. merger to grow US scale.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market Southwest accounts than your territory can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Magic Software off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brian, quick follow-up for Magic Software.

As US scale grows, regional pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Southwest region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brian, last bit of proof for Magic Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Magic Software's reply rate likely compares to other integration and low-code platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Southwest pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Matrix merger settles, no problem at all. Timing matters most mid-merger, and I know that stretch keeps a regional team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your regional motion? I'll tailor it to Magic Software either way.
